@dsh-external/dsh-nday-hunter

DSH Nday hunter (preset-plane, pentest): turn the Nday corpus into action — catalog query, fleet-scale fingerprint screening against machine-checkable probes, honest verdicts (screening signal is never reported as a vulnerability), and a ledger that hands the shortlist to the public exploitation tools.
